## Professional Summary
Ram Guinto is a front-end developer and aspiring AI engineer based in Manila, Philippines. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT) at National Teacher's College (NTC, 2023–Present). Ram specializes in modern responsive web development (React 19, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript) and practical AI integrations (OpenAI API, Gemini API, Claude API, Model Context Protocol). He has commercial internship experience in Front-End AI Engineering at FlyrankAI.

Ram is actively open to internships, entry-level front-end developer roles, and AI engineering opportunities.

## Detailed Project Catalog

### 1. DomoDomo (Co-Founder & Developer)
- **Live URL**: https://domodomo.site/
- **Category**: AI Web Utility Suite / Client-Side Tools
- **Tech Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, WebGPU, Vercel
- **Description**: A multi-purpose open-source utility suite that runs high-performance file conversions, image editing, and PDF manipulation 100% inside the browser sandbox. No server uploads; fully private and client-side.

### 2. Koncentrate
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Ram-Gold/koncentrate
- **Category**: Desktop Utility / Linux KDE Plasma 6 Widget
- **Tech Stack**: C++, Qt 6 / QML, Linux
- **Description**: A KDE Plasma 6 widget combining a Pomodoro focus timer with an integrated To-Do list to manage tasks and maintain productivity directly on the Linux desktop.

### 3. Idol Chant & Mixes
- **Live URL**: https://idol-mixes.vercel.app/
- **Category**: Community Web Application
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- **Description**: A centralized platform for learning and searching wotagei culture chants, calls, and mixes, addressing fragmentation in the community with interactive callouts.

### 4. Pubmats & Graphic Design Works
- **URL**: https://ram-gold.github.io/Personal-Website/?view=pubmats
- **Category**: Graphic Design / Event Media
- **Tools**: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma
- **Highlights**: Promotional flyers including BSIT Quiz Bee and EDSA Revolution Commemorative materials.
